prompt: I keep checking if I'm still here, like I might've slipped out of myself when I wasn't looking.
I keep waiting for someone to revoke my existence like I'm borrowing it under false pretenses.
My thoughts keep circling back to themselves like moths around a lightbulb that never quite burns out.
I keep trying to think my way out of thinking, like trying to use a net to catch water.
I keep thinking if I stay perfectly still, tomorrow won't notice I'm here and maybe forget to change me.
I keep waking up already tired, like my dreams took shifts I never signed up for.
I keep walking without checking if the ground remembers my footprints, like maybe if I don't look back I can pretend I'm going somewhere that matters.
I keep trying to forgive myself for closing my eyes to stars that never stopped shining just because I couldn't see them.
I keep folding myself smaller, like if I just compress enough, maybe the ache will finally fit in a pocket I can forget to check.
I keep circling back to the same bruise, pressing it like a button that plays every time I thought I had to be perfect to be allowed here.
I feel completely stuck in my career. I've been in the same role for five years and I don't know how to move forward.
I want to start my own business but I'm terrified of failing. My family depends on me financially.
I've been avoiding a difficult conversation with my business partner for months. I know it's holding us both back.
I set a goal last month to exercise three times a week but I haven't done it once. I feel like a failure.
I have so many ideas but I can't seem to finish anything. I start strong and then lose momentum halfway through.
I'm exhausted all the time and I don't know if it's the job or something else. I've been feeling this way for months.
My relationship with my manager is really difficult. I feel like nothing I do is ever good enough for them.
I want to improve my confidence when presenting to senior leadership. I freeze up every time.
I moved to a new city for work six months ago and I still haven't made any real friends. I feel isolated.
I keep saying yes to everything and I'm drowning in commitments. I don't know how to say no.
Give me three concrete action steps I can take this week to improve my time management.
Use the GROW model to help me set a clear goal around my fitness.
What specific questions should I ask my client to explore what is holding them back from their goal?
I want a numbered plan for how to approach a difficult conversation with my team member.
Help me create a SMART goal for increasing my client base by the end of the quarter.
What are the most important accountability questions a coach should ask each session?
Break down the steps I need to take to prepare for a job interview next week.
Give me a framework for prioritising tasks when everything feels equally urgent.
